email.subject: Gentle Dentistry: two quick fixes worth looking at
email.body:
Hi Kofi,

I checked Gentle Dentistry's site. Two things are likely costing you new patients: there's no online booking, so anyone searching after hours has no way to grab a slot and probably just calls the next dentist. And on mobile, your phone number isn't a tap-to-call link, so people have to copy and dial manually, which a lot just won't bother doing.

I also noticed no listed hours and no reviews on the site, which adds to the hesitation for a first-time patient.

I fix these for a flat fee. Happy to do a free 10-minute walkthrough showing exactly what I'd change, no obligation.

Worth a quick look?

Alex
